verdict.rationale: Rippling has an official CLI (rippling-cli) with 'Flux' commands letting developers create, manage, and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations, which could be invoked in scripts/CI, but there is no documentation of headless automation of core HR/payroll workflows or CI-specific guidance for the main product itself. missing for 10: evidence of CI-specific usage guides, headless/automation examples beyond integration deployment, and confirmation the CLI covers core product actions (not just integration publishing).
